channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Retirees are moving to this quiet North Carolina beach town to avoid Florida's heat, costs, and crowds
item.description: Florida's heat, crowds, and costs are pushing some retirees to a quieter corner of North Carolina: the beachy town of Calabash, NC.

item.title: This year's Netflix holiday movies ranked from worst to best
item.description: Netflix has released four new holiday movies this year, including "Jingle Bell Heist" and "A Merry Little Ex-Mas." See which ones are worth your time.

item.title: 5 of the best scents to wear this winter, according to professional perfumers
item.description: This winter, popular fragrances will include sweet gourmands, cozy amber, citruses, and heady, narcotic scents, according to professional perfumers.

item.title: I grew up in a house without family photos on the walls. I didn't realize what I was missing until I became a parent myself.
item.description: Growing up without family photos made home feel empty. As a parent, I fill my walls with pictures that tell our story.

item.title: I became a single mom of twins when my fiancé died unexpectedly. Grief rewired my ambition.
item.description: I became a single mom of twins when my fiancé died unexpectedly. My grief rewired inspired me to create a new path forward for all of us.

item.title: For five figures, you can 'own' a piece of Kanye West's unfinished Malibu house
item.description: A Tadao Ando-built home in Malibu once owned by rapper Kanye West was never finished. The current owner hopes to turn it into a social space.

item.title: Anthropic's resident philosopher shares her tips to create the best AI prompts
item.description: Amanda Askell, a member of Anthropic's technical team and a trained philosopher, shared some pro-tips for getting the most of AI chatbots.

item.title: My husband and I would break out sobbing when we first became empty nesters. We found joy together.
item.description: I thought the empty nest would be heartbreaking. Instead, I found freedom, creativity, and a new way to connect with my kids.

item.title: Justin Bieber is just like us: He's really mad about this annoying iPhone design feature
item.description: Justin Bieber's remark that he'll "find everyone at apple and put them in a rear naked choke hold" came as the company weathers a series of setbacks.

item.title: Users say they are seeing ads on ChatGPT. OpenAI says it's not true.
item.description: OpenAI's head of ChatGPT, Nick Turley, said OpenAI is not conducting any live tests for ads on the platform.
